patterns.label: Type 1 Suffix
patterns.explain: Type 1 suffixes are added to singular nouns (סוּס “horse” → סוּסִי “my horse”). Some prepositions and particles also take Type 1 suffixes.

patterns.label: Type 2 Suffix
patterns.explain: Type 2 suffixes are added to plural nouns (סוּסִים “horses” → סוּסַי “my horses”); most have a yod before the suffix. Some prepositions and particles also take Type 2 suffixes.

passages.title: Genesis 27:12–13
passages.note: Rebekah and Jacob: both suffix types in two short verses.
